pivot.title:
The ranch becomes
slopes in winter.
pivot.lead: Summer brings Tajima cattle grazing and animal encounters—the same grounds turn into Hyogo's compact family ski area in winter. One pair lift, four courses, a park-style winter day trip from Kansai.
pivot.noticeBody: Operations may change with snow and weather. Closed Thursdays (verify Ladies Day weeks on the official site). Call 0796-92-1005 or check online before departure.
pivot.imgAlt: Winter at Tajima Ranch Park—families on gentle slopes

primary.title: Kansai family snow hub
primary.lead: One pair lift with a mid-station—Paradise (beginner) through World (advanced, up to 36°). Roughly 30% beginner, 50% intermediate, 20% advanced for first-timers and step-up skiers in one day.
primary.imgAlt: Tajima Bokujo slopes—intermediate tree run with coastal views

secondary.title: Ladies Day & après-ski
secondary.lead: Half-price lift tickets for women junior-high and up on Ladies Day (often Thursday—confirm officially). After skiing, Yumura Onsen Refresh Park is ~15 minutes by car with tatami rest rooms.

camp.title:
Tajima cattle,
wide pasture sky.
camp.lead: Tajima Ranch Park is a prefectural park for nature and animals. Summer grazing, lawns, and viewpoints—the ski area brand is quiet, but the park campus drives year-round visits.
camp.imgAlt: Tajima Ranch Park—cattle and summer pasture

nordic.title:
Four courses,
one lift.
nordic.lead: Paradise (beginner), Sky Road & Pasture (intermediate), World (advanced)—fresh snow on ungroomed sections from the summit. Snowboards allowed everywhere. Weekday all-day lift from ¥2,500 adults (¥2,000 children).
nordic.noticeBody: Half-price lift for women junior-high and up on Ladies Day (day and eligibility—verify officially). May shift when it overlaps regular closure days.
nordic.imgAlt: Tajima Bokujo Ski Area—pair lift and four-course overview

journey.title:
From Kansai,
snow in a day.
journey.lead: From Osaka or Kobe via the Bantan Expressway—~60 minutes from Yoka-Hinozan IC on the Kitakinki-Toyooka Expressway. JR Hamasaka plus local bus also works. 200 free parking spaces suit family drives.

01.title: Osaka · Kobe · KIX
01.body: Bantan route → Yoka-Hinozan IC (~3 h zone)

05.title: Tajima food & views
05.body: Snow crab · Tajima beef on the way home

pivot.title: Winter pivot at the ranch park
pivot.body: Seasonal campus ops—cattle pasture becomes ski slopes. Sales focus: Kansai family awareness and a snow-info/mobile refresh where the legacy site is weak.

nordicGuide.title: Four courses & Ladies Day—compact design
nordicGuide.body: One pair lift with mid-station—wide beginner to 36° advanced. Thursday half-price Ladies Day builds repeat visits. LP fills the gap where live snow status is thin.

campGuide.title: Tajima Ranch Park—summer draw
campGuide.body: Tajima cattle and animal programs—year-round park branding supports weak ski-only awareness. Winter slopes plus summer ranch is the differentiator.

access.note: ~60 min by car from Yoka-Hinozan IC · ~45 min by bus from JR Hamasaka · 200 free parking spaces
